text: But round the end of a cucumber frame, whom should he meet but Mr. McGregor! Mr. McGregor was on his hands and knees planting out young cabbages, but he jumped up and ran after Peter, waving a rake and calling out, 'Stop thief!'
title: Peter Meets Mr. McGregor
director_note: I staged the meeting as a sudden reversal: Peter freezes in shock when he sees Mr. McGregor, then breaks into a desperate run while McGregor rises and charges after him with the rake. The foreground plants frame the chase without hiding the actors, keeping the first big action beat readable and urgent.
